entities.summary: Ferdinand Oyono was a political leaders in Ngoulemakong (1929-09-14, Ngoulemakong – 2010-06-10), a notable figure of the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
